arguments.analyst: Recent observations show K156R and T230N beneficial together; isolated I161L is beneficial, while nearby I161 substitutions vary. Test targeted menu variants around these signals.
arguments.hypothesis: K156R and T230 substitutions can support higher brightness, while the benefit at position 161 is specific to I161L rather than other substitutions.

decision.analyst: Recent observations show K156R and T230N beneficial together; isolated I161L is beneficial, while nearby I161 substitutions vary. Test targeted menu variants around these signals.
decision.hypothesis: K156R and T230 substitutions can support higher brightness, while the benefit at position 161 is specific to I161L rather than other substitutions.
decision.critic: Only O rows provide measured fluorescence; tool estimates are predictions, not measurements. The hypothesis that T230 substitutions or K156R help brightness is suggestive but not confirmed by these candidates. O10 also shows that I161 substitutions are not interchangeable.
decision.selection_rationale: Prioritize C01 (estimate 3.611) to test the K156R signal from O8, then C44 (3.551) to test a different T230 substitution. C18 (3.561) probes the broader position-161/163 region; C47 (3.559) contrasts K156E with K156R; C07 (3.565) offers a higher-estimate alternative without directly testing the hypothesis. Weakness: none of these designs isolates the observed K156R:T230N combination, and the model estimates are close and uncertain.
